name: remove_item
description: Removes an item from a character's or NPC's equipment list. Removes the first exact match. If quantity > 1, looks for the grouped entry 'item (xN)' created by give_item.

entity_type.description: Whether the target is a player character or an NPC.

entity.description: The slug or UUID of the character or NPC.

item.description: The item name to remove (must match an entry in the equipment list).

quantity.description: If > 1, removes the grouped entry 'item (xN)' rather than a plain item string. Defaults to 1.
